born.why: This code prioritizes safety by ignoring species with a history of harm, uses tasting for novel species only when safe (low hunger), and switches to carrying preferred fruits to the pantry unless starvation is imminent, thereby balancing exploration with resource management.

The code prioritizes safety by avoiding species with more harm records than fed records, confirms novel fruits with small tastes when hunger is manageable, and fully eats proven safe species, optimizing long-term survival by balancing exploration risk against immediate nutritional needs.

This code prioritizes survival by immediately avoiding any fruit species previously recorded as harmful (poisonous), while aggressively seeking out and consuming safe fruits when hungry, ensuring Fagi avoids starvation without risking death from known toxins.

The code prioritizes survival by overriding memory when starving, utilizes recent success to efficiently consume safe food, and uses a balanced heuristic (majority rule) to avoid poisonous species while remaining curious about novel ones only when safe from starvation.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding species with more poison records than feeding records, tasting unknowns only when safe hunger levels allow, and aggressively eating known-safe foods or seeking them out when hungry to maximize long-term energy intake while minimizing poisoning risk.

The code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between safe, harmful, and mixed fruit histories using a fed/harmed ratio, eating beneficial fruits fully when hungry, cautiously tasting or leaving harmful ones unless starving, and approaching only promising or non-desperate targets to maximize longevity.

This code improves safety by tracking the ratio of harmful vs. beneficial experiences for each specific fruit species, avoiding consumption only when poison is highly likely (>50%), while ensuring the ant seeks out food when hungry and avoids clearly toxic items.
